visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a blue t-shirt stands before a white door, holding a small ring box and attempting to place a ring on a woman's finger, though only her hand and forearm are visible. He has short dark hair and a focused expression. (2) Hard cut to a bright, modern kitchen where a woman in a strapless white wedding dress is vigorously sweeping the wooden floor with a grey broom and dustpan. The background features a black kitchen island and white cabinetry. (3) The scene returns to the man in the blue shirt, who now has a look of extreme shock or excitement, with his hands held near his face and mouth open. He continues to focus on the ring-sliding action on the woman's hand. (4) A fast-paced montage shows the woman in the wedding dress performing various chores: rinsing a glass in a white sink, spraying and wiping a white dining table, and flicking a pink patterned blanket over a made bed in a bedroom. (5) The woman continues chores: vacuuming a light-colored floor with a red and purple vacuum, loading white clothes into a dark grey front-load washing machine, scrubbing a white toilet with a blue brush, and carrying heavy trash bags and cardboard boxes out of the kitchen area. (6) Back to the man in the blue shirt, who is now laughing and smiling broadly as he carefully inches the ring onto the woman's finger. The shelf behind him is filled with colorful books and decorative items. (7) A final sequence shows the man, now in a grey t-shirt and athletic shorts, performing domestic tasks in the laundry room: loading the dryer, scrubbing the same toilet with a brush, and then struggling to carry a large cardboard box and heavy trash bags out through the front door into daylight.
